selected_evidence.summary: Shows the account, directory ownership and permissions, and a user-created persistence marker.

selected_evidence.requirement: Filesystem enforces a 100 MiB hard limit under /srv/data
selected_evidence.summary: XFS reports quota accounting and enforcement enabled with a 100M hard limit. Real 101 MiB writes failed with ENOSPC at the configured boundary both before and after restart.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 010056ff-8d5d-4b25-b2ce-773d5214a2e4, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 90f38edc-86bb-4333-9a75-e4776dce2f5b, active SSH, restored prjquota mount, unchanged marker checksum, retained 100M limit, and clean final state.
